title: stored configurations CFG0 to CFG3 with the model view
author: Claude-JG
description: A configuration stores the visualization settings and the model view, each as a dictionary that is empty by default and then changes nothing; CTRL and the icon store both; the store settings window stores the settings into CFGx, the store model view window the model view; the GUI storing function has flags for the settings and the model view; so a configuration can be a view, settings, or both.
releaseNotes: The stored configurations CFG0 to CFG3 keep the visualization settings and the model view, each changing nothing when empty; CTRL and an icon store both, the store settings and store model view windows store their part, exudyn.misc.GUI.StoreVisualizationSettings has storeSettings and storeModelView (revision2026c step RG6.19.9)
